claims.text: Move the derived vector index forward to match the authoritative journal.
claims.why: The docstring describes the class's purpose, but no code in this chunk shows the actual movement logic; it is a claim about behavior not present in this chunk.

claims.text: A batch is one HTTP request.  ``EventVectorStore``'s implicit backend times out at 10s, which a batch of 32 real journal entries can exceed on a cold model -- and a timeout is reported as ``embedder_unavailable``, i.e. an outage that never happened.  Own the backend so the timeout is a stated parameter rather than an accident of batch size.
claims.why: The comment explains design rationale referencing EventVectorStore and its behavior, none of which is present in this chunk. The claim about timeout reporting as embedder_unavailable cannot be verified here.

claims.text: model_revision is pinned, so this index_id differs from the one `daedalus context --latent` searches (that reader resolves a spec with model_revision=None). The latent half will report index_unavailable against this index.
claims.why: This warning string references behavior of `daedalus context --latent` and index_unavailable reporting, which are outside this chunk.

observations.what: WorkerReport.to_dict returns a dictionary with nested structures; no side effects.
_Progress dataclass has fields: scanned, projected, already, blank, malformed, embed_calls, malformed_lines.

_warnings returns a tuple of strings; currently only one warning about model_revision.
